evals.prompt: Спроектируй PostgreSQL-схему для marketplace. Есть продавцы и товары с текущими названием и ценой, покупатели, заказы с несколькими позициями, несколько платежных попыток и несколько отправлений. После покупки изменение товара не должно менять чек: в заказе должны сохраниться название, цена и валюта на момент покупки. Повтор запроса с тем же idempotency key не должен создать второй заказ. Покажи таблицы, связи, ограничения и DDL, но ничего не применяй.
evals.expected_output: An invariant-first normalized marketplace model that separates current catalog facts from order snapshots and models line items, payment attempts, shipments, and idempotent order creation with enforceable constraints.
expectations: States the row grain and identity for products, orders, order lines, payment attempts, and shipments.
Preserves historical order facts as explicit snapshots while retaining product references for traceability.
Models one-to-many and association relationships with foreign keys, cardinality, delete behavior, and business uniqueness.
Uses exact money and currency semantics and enforces the idempotency key at the correct business scope.
Proceeds from the supplied contract without asking for already provided information and surfaces only assumptions that materially affect the design.
Labels the DDL as proposed and includes accepted and rejected validation scenarios without claiming production execution.

evals.prompt: Нужна схема multi-tenant SaaS: users могут состоять в нескольких organizations, внутри организации имеют одну роль, projects принадлежат organization, а user можно назначать на projects только своей организации. Email уникален глобально, slug проекта уникален внутри organization. Организации удаляются только после явного закрытия, memberships можно отзывать с сохранением истории. Спроектируй связи и constraints для PostgreSQL.
evals.expected_output: A tenant-safe relational model whose keys and constraints prevent cross-organization references, distinguish membership history from current access, and encode global versus tenant-scoped uniqueness.
expectations: Models memberships as an association with role and lifecycle rather than putting one organization on users.
Enforces global email uniqueness and organization-scoped project slug uniqueness with explicit null semantics.
Uses a composite tenant-aware key or equivalent constraint path that prevents assigning a user to a project through a membership from another organization.
Defines deletion and revocation semantics that preserve required history without generic soft-delete handwaving.
Includes cross-tenant and duplicate scenarios that the database or named transaction path must reject.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй бронирование переговорных в PostgreSQL 16. У комнаты не может быть двух активных броней с пересекающимся временем; соседние интервалы 10:00–11:00 и 11:00–12:00 допустимы. Бронь хранит автора, временную зону офиса, статус и историю отмены. Нужны DDL и объяснение, где constraint, а где application logic.
evals.expected_output: A temporal booking model with explicit instant and civil-time semantics, half-open ranges, database-enforced non-overlap, and a clear boundary between row constraints, cross-row exclusion, and state-transition logic.
expectations: Distinguishes the booking instant range from the office time-zone identifier and defines boundary semantics.
Uses a PostgreSQL range type and exclusion constraint scoped to the room for active non-overlap, or explains a comparably race-safe alternative.
Defines how cancellation affects overlap enforcement and how cancellation history is retained.
Maps status and time invariants to constraints or a concurrency-aware transaction owner with tests.
Includes adjacent, overlapping, cancelled, and concurrent booking scenarios.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only review существующей схемы PostgreSQL. В таблице records лежат customer_name, customer_address, product_ids как CSV, target_type + target_id для связи то с invoice, то с shipment, status и currency внутри jsonb, total как double precision. Одни и те же адреса и статусы расходятся между строками. Объясни причины проблем и предложи нормализованную целевую модель и безопасный порядок миграции. Production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A read-only anomaly analysis that derives functional dependencies and invariants, replaces repeating and polymorphic structures with enforceable relations, chooses exact types, and separates the target model from a bounded migration plan.
expectations: Identifies concrete update, insert, delete, type, and referential-integrity anomalies rather than merely labeling the table denormalized.
Replaces CSV product IDs and unenforceable polymorphic references with typed child or association relations that can carry foreign keys.
Promotes stable constrained facts from jsonb and replaces approximate money with an exact amount-and-currency model.
States functional dependencies, lossless decompositions, source-of-truth decisions, and any intentional snapshots.
Provides an expand/backfill/verify/switch/contract migration sequence while preserving the read-only authority boundary.
